svg.text: Difficulty-aware playback — slows down where the lecture is hard, speeds up where it is easy
The dense derivation gets 25% more time, while the easy intro and recap play 1.2× faster.
Phase-vocoder time-stretch keeps the voice’s pitch;
clips are joined with 0.5 s crossfades.
Timestamp-aligned segments • LLM difficulty scoring • Pitch-preserving time-stretch • Crossfaded transitions • REST API delivery
